title: Last Stand
description: The remains of a previous expedition lie scattered across a small plateau — broken weapons, torn packs, and the ashen outlines of bodies that the void has already begun to reclaim. A makeshift barricade of dimensional debris suggests they fought hard before the end. Among the wreckage, supplies and equipment glint in the un-light.

choices.label: Salvage their equipment
choices.description: Search the fallen expedition's gear for anything still usable.

outcomes.text: Their packs still hold coin and crafting materials, protected by void-warded containers. You whisper thanks to the dead and take what they no longer need.
Most of the supplies are corrupted beyond use, but you find entropy residue crystallized in their shattered flasks. The dead have no use for it now.
As you search the bodies, one of them moves. Not alive — reanimated by the void's residual energy. It claws at your hero before crumbling to ash.

choices.label: Honor the fallen
choices.description: Take a moment to pay respects. Perhaps the dead will reward mercy.

outcomes.text: You arrange the remains with dignity and speak words for the lost. A warmth rises from the ground — not void energy, but something older. Something grateful. Your wounds ease.
The dead cannot hear you, but the act of kindness steadies your party's nerves. You notice a cache the fallen hid beneath a stone — their final insurance, now yours.
Your vigil draws unwanted attention. The scent of living flesh in the void is rare, and predators are always hunting. Something approaches from the darkness.

choices.label: Move on quickly
choices.description: Whatever killed them could still be nearby. You do not linger.

outcomes.text: You step carefully around the remains, eyes scanning the darkness. The dead watch you go with empty sockets, and you quicken your pace without looking back.
